toegepas.voor: Daarna het die pot gedroog en is dit in 'n vuur gebak.
toegepas.na: Daarna het die pot gedroog, en toe is dit in 'n vuur gebak.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The bare 'en is dit' leans on the fronted 'Daarna' and reads stiffly; 'toe' marks the next step, and the second clause then needs the AWS comma before 'en'.
toegepas.fout: Two clauses with their own subject and verb ('die pot ... gedroog', 'is dit ... gebak') are joined by 'en' without the AWS comma, and the carried-over inversion 'en is dit' reads stiffly.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Adds the required AWS comma and makes the next step explicit with 'toe', with the same actions in the same order.

toegepas.rede_vinder: In the previous sentence 'hulle' means the heads, so this 'Hulle' (the archaeologists) briefly points to the wrong noun.
toegepas.fout: 'Hulle' follows a clause where 'hulle' means the heads, so the reader briefly attaches it to the wrong noun.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming the archaeologists removes the pronoun stumble without changing who thinks what, and leaves the protected word 'argeoloë' intact.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: In natural Afrikaans the place phrase comes before the predicate adjective.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'word weer pap in water' is natural Afrikaans with the place phrase moved to the end, so the proposal only changes the word order.
